v4.6.54 — DAY bot stops skipping trades it doesn't actually hold

🐛 FIXED — DAY refused to enter tickers it didn't own
• After moving DAY to IBKR, its bracket list still contained positions it had placed on Alpaca, so it kept skipping them ('already has an open bracket') and wouldn't re-enter — even though it held nothing on IBKR.
• DAY now reconciles its open brackets against the positions it ACTUALLY holds on the active broker each cycle, clearing any stale entries (with a short grace period so a just-placed bracket isn't dropped before it fills). It can trade freely again on its IBKR slice.

Follows v4.6.53 (DAY/LONG now trade their IBKR slice instead of Alpaca). All four IBKR cloud bots are clean and trading their own allocation.

Update via the in-app banner.
